SELECT question.id, COALESCE(question_submit.question_result, 0) AS status, question.title, question.tags, question.accepted_number, question.submit_number, CASE WHEN question_collections.question_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS collected FROM question LEFT JOIN ( -- 获取用户对每个题目的最新提交记录 SELECT qs_inner.question_id, qs_inner.user_id, # qs_inner.judge_status qs_inner.question_result FROM question_submit qs_inner INNER JOIN ( SELECT question_id, MAX(id) AS max_id -- 根据最大ID确定最新提交 FROM question_submit WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY question_id ) qs_latest ON qs_inner.id = qs_latest.max_id ) question_submit ON question.id = question_submit.question_id LEFT JOIN question_collections ON question.id = question_collections.question_id AND question_collections.user_id = #{userId} AND question_collections.is_deleted = 0
AND question.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND question.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
AND question.id = #{id}
AND question.author_id = #{authorId}
AND question.id IN ( SELECT question_id FROM question_collections WHERE user_id = #{userId} and question_collections.is_deleted = 0 )
ORDER BY question.id ASC

select question.id, title, content, tags, judge_config , author_id, CASE WHEN question_collections.question_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS collected from question left join question_collections on question.id = question_collections.question_id and question_collections.user_id = #{userId} and question_collections.is_deleted = 0 where question.id = #{id} and question.is_deleted = 0
